name: West Town

features.name: Flush Royal
features.description: Five different cards in the middle row pay 15x.

features.name: Bandit free spins
features.description: 10 free spins per bandit in the trigger combination.

review:
A 2016 nine-line western with a poker twist. A joker is wild for the card symbols, and five different cards across the middle row make a 'Flush Royal' that multiplies wins by 15x.

The sheriff badge, wanted poster and bandit together award 10 free spins per bandit, and free spins come round often – about once every 56 spins. Low volatility, a 570x cap and 96.95% RTP. Gentle and relaxing.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 56 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
